sources.limitations: Unverified community archive of historical game CSV/assets. Its public version index stops at v18.200.9, whereas the frozen TH18 reference requires later version-identified data; the README also says versions may be missing. Its traps.csv maps the historical Seeking Air Mine to LargeDarkElixirBalloon, whose projectiles.csv Speed is 350; this agrees with the official 3.5 tiles/s value under a 100 internal-units-per-tile inference. That cross-check calibrates this historical snapshot only, not a current TH18 build. It cannot establish current flight speeds, launch/impact order or TH18 fidelity.
